segments.text: “Now these are the ordinances which you shall set before them:
“If you buy a Hebrew servant, he shall serve six years, and in the seventh he shall go out free without paying anything.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: If he comes in by himself, he shall go out by himself. If he is married, then his wife shall go out with him.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: But if the servant shall plainly say, ‘I love my master, my wife, and my children. I will not go out free;’
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: then his master shall bring him to God, and shall bring him to the door or to the doorpost, and his master shall bore his ear through with an awl, and he shall serve him forever.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: “If a man sells his daughter to be a female servant, she shall not go out as the male servants do.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: If she doesn’t please her master, who has married her to himself, then he shall let her be redeemed. He shall have no right to sell her to a foreign people, since he has dealt deceitfully with her.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: If he marries her to his son, he shall deal with her as a daughter.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: If he takes another wife to himself, he shall not diminish her food, her clothing, and her marital rights.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: If he doesn’t do these three things for her, she may go free without paying any money.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: “One who strikes a man so that he dies shall surely be put to death,
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: but not if it is unintentional, but God allows it to happen; then I will appoint you a place where he shall flee.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: If a man schemes and comes presumptuously on his neighbor to kill him, you shall take him from my altar, that he may die.
“Anyone who attacks his father or his mother shall be surely put to death.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: “Anyone who kidnaps someone and sells him, or if he is found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: “Anyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: “If men quarrel and one strikes the other with a stone, or with his fist, and he doesn’t die, but is confined to bed;
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: if he rises again and walks around with his staff, then he who struck him shall be cleared; only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall provide for his healing until he is thoroughly healed.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: “If a man strikes his servant or his maid with a rod, and he dies under his hand, the man shall surely be punished.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: Notwithstanding, if his servant gets up after a day or two, he shall not be punished, for the servant is his property.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: “If men fight and hurt a pregnant woman so that she gives birth prematurely, and yet no harm follows, he shall be surely fined as much as the woman’s husband demands and the judges allow.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: But if any harm follows, then you must take life for life,
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: burning for burning, wound for wound, and bruise for bruise.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: “If a man strikes his servant’s eye, or his maid’s eye, and destroys it, he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: If he strikes out his male servant’s tooth, or his female servant’s tooth, he shall let the servant go free for his tooth’s sake.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: “If a bull gores a man or a woman to death, the bull shall surely be stoned, and its meat shall not be eaten; but the owner of the bull shall not be held responsible.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: But if the bull had a habit of goring in the past, and this has been testified to its owner, and he has not kept it in, but it has killed a man or a woman, the bull shall be stoned, and its owner shall also be put to death.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: If a ransom is imposed on him, then he shall give for the redemption of his life whatever is imposed.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: Whether it has gored a son or has gored a daughter, according to this judgment it shall be done to him.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: If the bull gores a male servant or a female servant, thirty shekels of silver shall be given to their master, and the ox shall be stoned.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

footnotes.text: + A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces, so 30 shekels is about 300 grams or about 10.6 ounces.

segments.text: “If a man opens a pit, or if a man digs a pit and doesn’t cover it, and a bull or a donkey falls into it,
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: the owner of the pit shall make it good. He shall give money to its owner, and the dead animal shall be his.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: “If one man’s bull injures another’s, so that it dies, then they shall sell the live bull, and divide its price; and they shall also divide the dead animal.
segments.speaker: Yahweh

segments.text: Or if it is known that the bull was in the habit of goring in the past, and its owner has not kept it in, he shall surely pay bull for bull, and the dead animal shall be his own.
segments.speaker: Yahweh
